notes: Ruled grid form; boxes are ruled-cell interiors inset 0.5pt (from the PDF's thin filled-rect rules) or, where a label shares its cell, the cell from just after the label to the cell edge. Y/N, Past/Present and Mom/Dad/Sibling marking cells are choice boxes (the cells themselves; there are no printed squares). Gender Identity / Sex assigned at birth checkboxes are drawn as images (no text layer for those option words); their rects are the measured box glyphs. '(circle)' groups (Frequently/Rarely/Never, migraine Rare/Occasional/Frequent, Anal/Oral/Vaginal, partner sex, HPV vaccine doses, STDs, birth-control methods, pap abnormal/normal) are one choice box per option word (word bbox). 'Other:' options also get a text box for the write-in. Local Address and pregnancy Complications are unruled 2-line cells: line 1 (after the label) carries the path, line 2 is pathless. Excluded: 'Provider Signature/comments' and its Date (staff only). Pathless by choice (the schema does not keep them): Cell Phone Carrier, emergency-contact Work Phone, quit attempts / want to quit, the 'Any questions or concerns' Y/N flags, migraine frequency, HPV vaccine doses, the BSE-education and testicular self-exam Past/Present boxes, the two personal-history 'Other' rows' Past/Present boxes and the right-column Other write-in; signature has no path.
